decisions.subject: Composition runtime

options_considered.label: HyperFrames（素材生成器）
options_considered.reason: 每个场景是 military-* 技能产出的确定性 HTML/GSAP 合成，assets 阶段渲染成 MP4

options_considered.label: Remotion（React 场景栈）
options_considered.reason: 无 military 场景栈，额外 authoring tokens 无视觉增益

options_considered.label: FFmpeg（终裁运行时）
options_considered.reason: 场景 MP4 拼接 + ASS 字幕烧录 + 配音/音乐 mux 的原生路径

decisions.reason: HyperFrames 产场景素材，ffmpeg 做最终合成；render_runtime 记录为 ffmpeg

decisions.subject: Narration TTS provider

options_considered.label: edge-tts zh-CN-YunxiNeural（中文男声）

options_considered.label: OpenAI gpt-4o-mini-tts
options_considered.reason: 需 API key，当前未配置

decisions.reason: 本地可用中文男声，军政 register 匹配

decisions.subject: Background music plan

options_considered.label: API 生成（suno_music）
options_considered.reason: 低音铜管 pulse 能托住军政 tension register

decisions.reason: 军政 tension underbed，无 vocals；若生成不可用则降级为无音乐

decisions.subject: Where generation_spec lives in scene_plan

options_considered.label: On each scene item (scene-director doc example)
options_considered.reason: scene_plan.schema.json sets additionalProperties:false on scene items and does not declare generation_spec — fails artifact validation

options_considered.label: metadata.generation_specs keyed by scene id
options_considered.reason: scene_plan.metadata is a free-form object; keeps artifact schema-valid while preserving the exact per-scene spec the asset stage consumes

decisions.reason: Schema-legal placement; asset-director reads the spec via scene id from the same artifact

decisions.subject: Opener + chapter card windows on a linear timeline

options_considered.label: Cursor-accumulated linear timeline; opener/chapter cards hold real seconds
options_considered.reason: Schema-valid; section scene durations match script; total 155.2s is +5.5% of 147.1s — inside the ±10% gate

decisions.reason: Schema-valid, deterministic, and edit/compose can lay scenes end-to-end without gaps
